async def act(page):
    # Fill the project name textbox with 'Hello'
    project_name_input = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Project name')
    await project_name_input.fill('Hello')
    
    # Wait for the Save changes button to become enabled (not disabled)
    save_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Save changes')
    await save_button.wait_for(state='visible', timeout=5000)  # Wait for button to be visible
    # Check if button is disabled and wait until it's not
    while await save_button.get_attribute('disabled'):
        await page.wait_for_timeout(500)  # Wait 500 ms and check again
    
    # Click the Save changes button
    await save_button.click()
    
    # Wait for navigation or page update to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
